notFound.title: Invite not found
notFound.body: This link doesn’t match a valid invitation. Double-check the URL or ask the person who invited you to send a new one.

used.title: Invite already used
used.body: This invitation has already been accepted. If that wasn’t you, ask the account admin to send a fresh link.

expired.title: Invite expired
expired.body: This invitation has expired. Ask the account admin to send a new one — they take a few seconds to generate.

serverError.title: Something went wrong
serverError.body: We couldn’t verify this invitation right now. Try refreshing the page in a moment.

invite.title: You're invited to <accent>{accountName}</accent>
invite.description: You'll join as <role>{roleLabel}</role>. Link valid until {date}.

accept.helper: Accepting moves your login into <accent>{accountName}</accent>. Your empty personal account from signup will be cleaned up.

conflict.title: Can't join {accountName} with this account
conflict.body: To join <accent>{accountName}</accent>, sign out and sign up again with a different email address. The invite link stays valid as long as it hasn't expired.
conflict.signOutButton: Sign out & use a different email

toast.conflictDefault: You are already in another account. Sign in with a different email to join this one.
toast.signOutError: Could not sign out. Try refreshing the page.
